{{Top|leg}}
A '''Scoop''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] equipment that allowed a vessel to take needed materials directy from a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] or [[Water/Legends|sea]] to recharge [[Fuel cell/Legends|fuel cells]].

The device was most commonly found mounted on [[Scout_ship/Legends|scout ships]].<ref name="GG6-TrampF">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref>
